purpose: Test whether the larger BGE reranker v2 Gemma model is worth scaling over the frozen BGE-M3 hybrid r100 Arabic MIRACL top-100 candidate pool.
research_basis: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-gemma is a larger multilingual FlagEmbedding LLM reranker and is a plausible stronger reranker than BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3.

Qwen3 reranker research suggests larger instruction-aware rerankers are important SOTA-grade retrieval-system references, but BGE-gemma is the lower-risk next gate because it uses the same BGE/FlagEmbedding stack as the current best system.
The gate must beat the existing v46 BGE-reranker-v2-m3 same-slice control before a full-dev run is justified.

source.notes: The first v55 launch using the default Hugging Face Xet path repeatedly timed out while fetching the model. v55b restarted with HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 and reused the cache.

decision: Promising gate: BGE-reranker-v2-gemma beats the same 200-query first-stage score and the v46 BGE-reranker-v2-m3 gate. It is worth a full-dev run, but the current strongest confirmed full-dev system is v56 score blending over v47 because v56 already reaches 0.828605 nDCG@10.
next_experiment: Run full-dev BGE-reranker-v2-gemma over the frozen v43 candidate pool, then test the same min-max score blend against the v56 system.
